assumptions: BATCH 111 IS THE SOCIAL FOREIGN KEY, AND §6's REGISTRY GIVES IT TO A0 BY NAME ("111 | A0 Integration | 110,020,081 | business-channel/social FK | A0 only"). It is the first batch in this package whose author is the package Author, which the three role runs on it were told and recorded.

THE KEY IS (workspace_id, social_account_id) -> app.social_accounts (workspace_id, id), composite over the workspace because a social account belongs to a Workspace and a target to a Business inside it. It delivers the social half of the registry row and DECLINES the business-channel half: §4 relation invariant 2 binds an account to one active Business at a time, the binding has no table (020, 110 and now 111 declined it), and a business-scoped key would encode it in a column pair that does not exist.

THE THREE DESTINATION SYMBOLS BATCH 081 FIXED ARE RETIRED for social_account_a1/a2/b1, fixed by the catalog recipe; 110's fixture fixes the ids it used to let default and loads a second workspace_a account so one item can hold two destinations. 081 said the fixture would refuse to load until 111 did this; the repoint is the fix rather than a red run.

A PostgreSQL 17.11 EXISTS ON THIS MACHINE and every claim below was measured on a scratch cluster of it before push: without 111 the database accepts the cross-tenant row (A1-081 S3 reproduced); with it, 845 cases, the one new case refused 23503. CI read the same numbers on the branch name.

THREE ROLE RUNS SIGNED THIS BATCH BEFORE MERGE (Owner's Q6), same-vendor under RFC-2026-024's proposal: A1 (3 LOW), C0 (3 MEDIUM, 5 LOW, 2 INFO), Q0. C0's M1, M2, M3, L3 and L4 and A1's F3 were acted on in the branch before merge: two header sentences corrected, eight stale sentences corrected, two blockers opened, one extended, this handoff rewritten.

security_privacy_cost_impact: Closes A1-081 S3: a content target can no longer name a social account of another Workspace -- the reference is refused at the database (23503) in both directions (A1-111 measured B->A as well). Adds no grant, no policy, no read surface; A1-111 F1 records the referential check as a one-bit own-tenant channel to social_accounts with values redacted, LOW. No cost today: content_targets is empty on every database the repository has when the key is validated.
migration_and_data_impact: One unique key on app.social_accounts (workspace_id, id); one index and one composite foreign key on app.content_targets, added NOT VALID and validated in the same batch. Invariant 2 in shape; the column has held values since 081 and there is nothing to backfill. No ON DELETE action -- an open blocker. Fixture changes: 110 fixes three social-account ids and adds a row; 081 repoints three literals; the three destination catalog symbols are retired.
compatibility_impact: Any writer that names a destination must name a social account of its own Workspace that exists. Nothing in the repository writes one except the fixtures and the cases, all repointed.
known_limitations: THE BUSINESS-CHANNEL HALF OF §6 ROW 111 IS NOT DELIVERED; the binding has no table and this batch is not the one to create it.
content_targets_social_scope_fk has no ON DELETE action; what happens to a target whose account disappears is an open blocker.
No lint holds a foreign key to a supporting index; twenty-one keys lack one (C0-111 M1). This batch indexed its own.
§6 row 120 does not list 111 among its dependencies; the registry is read-only to this package.
open_risks_or_blockers: The business-channel half of §6 row 111 is not delivered; the binding table has no owner (blocker extended).
No ON DELETE action on the key (blocker opened).
No FK supporting-index lint; twenty-one keys lack an index (blocker opened).
§6 row 120 does not list 111; the registry is docs/** and read-only here.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert the merge commit: the key, the unique key and the index go; the catalog and fixtures return to symbols that name no row, which is the state 081 left on purpose. No database this repository has holds a content target outside a fixture.
recommended_next_work_packages: The FK supporting-index rule, then the twenty-one indexes or reasoned exemptions (blocker).
The channel binding table (§4 invariant 2), which 020, 110 and 111 have each declined; needs an owner in §6.
Batch 120 (Publisher), whose registry row should list 111.
